bio.text: Ted Budd has been a U.S. Senator from North Carolina since being sworn in on January 3, 2023, after winning election on November 8, 2022.
He served three terms in the U.S. House after first being elected in 2016, and grew up on a farm in Davie County, where he still lives.
He holds a B.B.A. from Appalachian State University, a master's degree from Dallas Theological Seminary, and an M.B.A. from Wake Forest University.
